currency.basis: Wikipedia's current infobox logo for ING Group is the 2024 rebrand design (standing lion + ING wordmark); the catalog's lion-head-in-circle is the pre-2024 emblem. No source shows the old circle emblem in current use.

identity.basis: The record is ING Romania (ING Bank Romania), part of ING Group; the candidate is ING Group's official current logo, the brand under which the Romanian bank operates.

assessment.independenceRationale: Wikipedia article and Commons file page are one publication family (Wikimedia); ing.ro/ing.com could not be reached from this host. Currency rests on the encyclopedia's current-logo usage plus the global single-brand structure of ING; recorded the access limitation.

variant.basis: The standing lion appears standalone in ING's current identity (app icon, favicons, social avatars); using the lion without the wordmark is the non-text variant of the same brand mark. Working candidate preserves the exact lion subtree from the current full-logo vector.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All lion details (mane strokes, face features, tail tuft, white body detail paths) preserved; source/final pairs on both themes show no lost or invented details after SVGO.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Lion aspect preserved by uniform scale (102.1x65.7 user units scaled 0.7605); centered with even clearances in the 54x54 cell; no stretching or cropping.
candidate.rationale: Evidenced 2024 ING global rebrand: the catalog's pre-2024 lion-head-in-circle emblem is obsolete; ING's current identity is the redesigned standing lion with raised tail. Update replaces the obsolete emblem with the current design; the 'ING' wordmark is excluded per catalog standalone-symbol suitability.
candidate.role: Standalone non-text brand symbol (standing lion), the non-text variant of ING's current logo; no backing field, transparent mark.
transforms: Selected the complete lion subtree (g19 with its ancestor transforms) verbatim from the current full-logo vector; the navy #091c5a 'ING' wordmark group (g11) excluded as separate lettering per catalog suitability.
Uniform scale 0.7605 and translation to fit and center the lion in a 54x54 canvas (catalog convention); no other geometry, color or structure change.

proposals.reason: Current catalog icon is the pre-2024 ING emblem (orange lion head in a white circle). ING's current global identity (2024 rebrand) uses a redesigned standing lion with raised tail alongside the navy #091c5a ING wordmark. The bank's single global brand applies to ING Bank Romania, so the catalog mark is an obsolete design; an evidenced update for the same bank. Candidate asset is the current full logo vector (Wikimedia copy of the official logo); the working candidate carries the exact lion subtree with the wordmark excluded per catalog suitability.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Evidenced 2024 ING global rebrand: the catalog's pre-2024 lion-head-in-circle is obsolete; current identity is the redesigned standing lion. Update replaces the obsolete emblem with the current design (wordmark excluded for catalog suitability).

sources.independenceGroup: Wikipedia article and its linked upload.wikimedia.org file are one publication

This is the 2024 global rebrand design, not the old lion-head-in-circle. Rendered locally from the fetched bytes: lion subset is complete and self-contained.
